Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the "Parliament of Scotland" as the primary answer based on the search results, without verifying if the question referred to the English Parliament (which is the more common historical reference for the "Directory of Public Worship" in the context of the Westminster Assembly's ratification by the Long Parliament). The search results explicitly stated it was approved by the Parliament of England (Long Parliament) in 1644 and the Parliament of Scotland in 1645. The Planner's decision to focus solely on the Scottish Parliament led to an incorrect final answer, as the modern equivalent of the English Parliament (the UK Parliament) has been based at the Palace of Westminster since 1547 (and certainly continuously since 2004), whereas the Scottish Parliament moved to its current location in 2004. The failure to clarify which parliament the question referred to or to consider the English one as the primary candidate constitutes the initial error.
